Q1_weno7_observed_order.quantity: observed order p of WENO7 on the 3200->6400 pair
Q1_weno7_observed_order.mechanism: L1 of a shock/contact-dominated solution is O(h) with a constant set by the number of cells in the smearing bands; raising the reconstruction order changes the constant, not the exponent

Q2_cross_order_gap_3200.mechanism: same-resolution reference truncation shrinks, so the gap should be the same order as the WENO5 3200->6400 self-certification (0.9554%)

Q3_weno7_u_ref_6400.mechanism: must undercut U_ref^WENO5(12800) = 0.7181%, otherwise the order-upgrade route is not cheaper than refinement

Q4_reference_side_share_pp.quantity: L1(MUSCL@3200 vs WENO7@6400) - L1(MUSCL@3200 vs WENO5@12800) [percentage points]
Q4_reference_side_share_pp.mechanism: the reference floor drops 0.72% -> 0.40%; the graded-side error is unchanged

Q5_certified_still_false.quantity: honest bound = L1(MUSCL@3200 vs WENO7@6400) + U_ref^WENO7(6400) < 1 % ?
Q5_certified_still_false.mechanism: at most ~0.5 pp of the 1.78% can be reference-side; the remainder keeps the graded solution above the 1% bar

Q6_peak_ratio.quantity: peak(MUSCL@3200 vs WENO7@6400) / peak(MUSCL@3200 vs WENO5@12800), denominator 0.758 %
Q6_peak_ratio.mechanism: the peak is already converged to 0.023% inside the WENO5 family, so a change of reconstruction order should barely move it
